# Dungeons & Areas Encyclopedia

## Dungeon Types

### Natural Caves

| Type | Features | Dangers |
|------|----------|----------|
| Limestone | Stalactites, rivers | Falling, drowning |
| Volcanic | Lava, sulfur | Burns, gases |
| Sea Cave | Tides, marine | Drowning, traps |
| Deep | Darkness, echoes | Getting lost |

### Built Structures

| Type | Features | Dangers |
|------|----------|----------|
| Castle | Walls, towers, traps | Guards, traps |
| Crypt | Undead, tombs | Undead, curses |
| Temple | Altars, guardians | Divine magic, traps |
| Mine | Tunnels, ore | Monsters, collapse |
| Sewer | Rats, disease | Disease, drowning |
| Prison | Cells, locked doors | Guards, traps |

## Room Types (Standard)

| Room | Common Features | Potential Threats |
|------|-------------------|------------------|
| Entry | Doors, initial traps | None |
| Corridor | Doors, bends | Traps |
| Chamber | Furniture, loot | Monsters |
| Intersection | Choices | None |
| Guard Room | Guards | Combat |
| Storage | Supplies | Monsters, traps |
| Armory | Weapons | None |
| Treasury | Loot | Traps, guardians |
| Prison | Cells | Undead, NPCs |
| Shrine | Altar, divine | Divine guardian |
| Lab | Experiments | Alchemical hazards |
| Library | Books | Construct guardians |
| Bedroom | Beds | Assassins |
| Kitchen | Food | None |

## Room Generation

### Small (10x10)
- 1-2 features
- 1 encounter (10%)

### Medium (20x20)
- 2-4 features
- 1 encounter (25%)

### Large (40x40)
- 4-6 features
- 1 encounter (50%)

- Hidden area (25%)


### Huge (80x80)
- 8-10 features
- 2 encounters (50%)
- Multiple areas
- Secret areas (50%)


## Dungeon Generation

### Level 1-3 (Easy)
- Goblins, skeletons
- Simple traps
- Basic loot
- 3-5 rooms

### Level 4-7 (Medium)
- Hobgoblins, orcs
- Moderate traps
- Good loot
- 6-10 rooms

### Level 8-11 (Hard)
- Hobgoblins, ogres
- Complex traps
- Great loot
- 10-15 rooms

### Level 12+ (Extreme)
- Giants, dragons
- Multiple traps
- Legendary loot
- 15+ rooms

## Dungeon Generation Seeds

### Village Sewer
- 4 rooms
- Rats, kobolds
- 50 gp average

### Abandoned Mine
- 8 rooms
- Skeletons, beetles
- 200 gp

### Pirate Cave
- 10 rooms
- Undead, traps
- 500 gp

### Lich Tomb
- 15 rooms
- Undead, traps
- 2,000 gp

### Dragon Lair
- 20 rooms
- Dragon, wyrmlings
- 10,000 gp
